plan.operation: native expander setup, full encode, ordered query and full integer validation
plan.fixture: limb k of input i = (37*i+17*k+9) mod p; fixed zero setup seed
plan.fixture_scope: nonzero structured full-field inputs; value-independent encoding loops
plan.query_columns: [2*n-1,0,n,0]; nonempty eval_row re-encodes the whole row
plan.validation: separate integer sparse evaluator, independently derived dense Circle base; shares fixed hash block primitive already checked against Python
plan.timing: includes input allocation, setup regeneration, encoding, query allocation/full re-encoding and every-symbol validation; excludes build, process launch, argument parsing, final drops and stdout
plan.heap: actual native live heap capacities, including graph, recursive overlap, base transforms, retained caller input/output/id and query result; excludes validator, stack, runtime and allocator metadata
plan.process_memory: separate worker peak RSS includes all native and integer validation buffers/runtime; controller excluded
plan.counters: sparse K additions and K-by-base products counted from exact loop geometry; base transforms add 1280 K additions and 704 K multiplications per encode; base twiddle construction/inversion work is timed but not included in those arithmetic counters
plan.warmup: release tests, independent oracle checks and j=3 field=1 receipt smoke in separate processes
plan.scope: CPU encoder microbenchmark only, no proof/profile/GPU claim or cost-model fit

distance_estimates.scope: Sampled upper bounds, not distance certificates or profile parameters

note: Full native encoding and query with actual setup regeneration for every sample, all outputs checked by a separate integer evaluator. All three fields and all repetitions retained. Native heap capacities and whole-process peaks have different stated scopes. Setup hashing, full query re-encoding and complete validation are included, not amortized. Arithmetic counters distinguish sparse/transform K work and exclude timed twiddle preparation. Distance witnesses are sampled upper observations only. Standard is a schema tag, no profile or inference evidence, performance comparison or fitted constant.
